title: Preview the registered launch
when: Immediately before staffing an item or an itemless mandate
need: Use registered launch preview/create; the engine composes item mandates. Read the selected level, machine and blockers. The opening hook binds through its launch-specific attestation, never folder/time proximity. An assigned worker must acknowledge and claim its own item before the deadline. Missing entry names launch_work_claim_missing and releases launch-only staffing. Read launch get for the exact session and recovery evidence.
surface: Steer worker-launch and model-selection -> launch help/preview.
recipes: yoke session-control launch preview --project P --level SENIOR
